# stripe_apple_pay_domain (Data Source)

A domain registered for Apple Pay. `terraform destroy` deletes the domain. Stripe accepts the same domain name more than once, so changing `domain_name` creates a new registration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_apple_pay_domain" "checkout" {
  domain_name = "pay.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_name` (String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
